segments.time: Day, rainy outside, bright soft daylight through the windows with warm interior fill
segments.first_state: There is one large walnut desk with one black leather executive chair behind it. The floor-to-ceiling windows stand behind the desk. The single office door is on the side wall facing the desk, with open floor between the door and the desk. The black leather sofas sit around the white marble coffee table in the lounge area to one side. Lin Qingyu stands just inside the office door, in the open space facing the desk. He is soaked, his hair dripping and his white T-shirt clinging under the open denim jacket, and he is out of breath. Xu Banxia holds the office door open beside him. Ji Ran stands in front of the walnut desk, facing Lin Qingyu. The axis runs from the office door to the desk, and the camera stays on the lounge-area side of it.

shots.camera: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the lounge-area side; office door on frame left, walnut desk on frame right
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu stands soaked and panting just inside the office door. Xu Banxia holds the door beside him. Ji Ran stands in front of the walnut desk facing him.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Chinese, breathless and apologetic): {抱歉，我来晚了。} <rain patters faintly on the windows>

shots.camera: Medium close-up, handheld, eye-level, from the lounge-area side, centered on Lin Qingyu
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu pushes wet hair off his forehead. Water drips from his chin as he catches his breath.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Chinese, fast and flustered): {没想到今天下这么大雨，}

shots.camera: Medium shot, slow push in on Ji Ran, eye-level, from the lounge-area side
shots.visual: Ji Ran stands in front of the walnut desk. Her eyes travel slowly from his face down his clinging wet T-shirt.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Chinese, fast and flustered): {我自行车链子掉了，一路跑过来的。}

shots.camera: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Ji Ran's face
shots.visual: Ji Ran keeps her mouth closed and gives a faint, appraising half-smile. One brow lifts.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, V.O., in Chinese, cool and appraising): {脸长得好，身材也不错，带出去够有面。}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, at the office door from the lounge-area side
shots.visual: Xu Banxia presses her lips together to hold back a laugh and steps out. She pulls the office door shut behind Lin Qingyu.

shots.camera: Wide shot, high angle, slow orbit following Ji Ran on the lounge-area side of the axis
shots.visual: Ji Ran folds her arms and walks a slow half circle around Lin Qingyu, inspecting him from head to toe. He stands stiffly in the open space in front of the desk.

shots.camera: Close-up insert, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Lin Qingyu's stomach
shots.visual: Ji Ran's index finger pokes Lin Qingyu's abs through the wet white T-shirt four times, and the fabric dents with each poke.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, in Chinese, flat and counting): {一、二、三、四。} <a cartoon boing sound with each poke>

shots.camera: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Ji Ran from the lounge-area side
shots.visual: Ji Ran stops in front of Lin Qingyu on the desk side, refolds her arms and looks up at his face.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, in Chinese, crisp and businesslike): {你叫什么名字？}

shots.camera: Close-up, slight low angle, handheld, on Lin Qingyu's face
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu swallows hard. Sweat beads on his forehead and his eyes dart away.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Chinese, stammering): {林、林青羽。}

segments.light_audio: Bright soft daylight through the floor-to-ceiling windows behind the desk, warm recessed ceiling spots and the brass desk lamp fill. Live sound: faint rain on the glass, heels on the floor, the door closing, cartoon boing on each poke.

dialogue.speaker: lin_qingyu
dialogue.line: 抱歉，我来晚了。 没想到今天下这么大雨，我自行车链子掉了，一路跑过来的。

dialogue.speaker: ji_ran
dialogue.line: 脸长得好，身材也不错，带出去够有面。

dialogue.speaker: ji_ran
dialogue.line: 一、二、三、四。 你叫什么名字？

must_hit: Soaked Lin Qingyu apologizes at the office door
Xu Banxia holds back a laugh and leaves, closing the door
Ji Ran circles Lin Qingyu and pokes his stomach four times
segments.exit_state: Lin Qingyu stands soaked in the open space in front of the walnut desk, with the closed office door behind him. He is sweating and stiff. Ji Ran stands facing him at arm's length on the desk side of him, with her arms folded. Xu Banxia is gone. The camera stays on the lounge-area side.
negative: Xu Banxia remaining in the room after the door closes
dry clothes or dry hair on Lin Qingyu

segments.time: Day, rainy outside, bright soft daylight through the windows with warm interior fill
segments.first_state: Lin Qingyu stands soaked in the open space in front of the walnut desk, with the closed office door behind him. He is sweating and stiff. Ji Ran stands facing him at arm's length on the desk side of him, with her arms folded. Xu Banxia is gone. The camera stays on the lounge-area side.

shots.camera: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Lin Qingyu's shoulder, eye-level, from the lounge-area side
shots.visual: Past Lin Qingyu's wet shoulder, Ji Ran stands in front of the walnut desk with her arms folded and nods once.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, in Chinese, brisk): {嗯，身高？}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, low angle, locked-off camera, on Lin Qingyu
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu straightens up to his full height and squares his shoulders.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Chinese, eager): {一米八六。}

shots.camera: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Ji Ran
shots.visual: Ji Ran's eyes flick up and down his body.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, in Chinese, clipped): {体重？}

shots.camera: Medium shot, handheld, eye-level, on Lin Qingyu from the lounge-area side
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu wipes the sweat from his forehead with the back of his hand.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Chinese, quick): {六十四公斤。}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, slight push in, eye-level, on Ji Ran
shots.visual: Ji Ran tilts her head and narrows her eyes.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, in Chinese, clipped): {年龄？}

shots.camera: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Lin Qingyu's face
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu flashes a hopeful, boyish smile.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lin Qingyu, in Chinese, bright): {二十一。}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Ji Ran in front of the walnut desk
shots.visual: Ji Ran's shoulders drop as she lets out a long, disappointed sigh and unfolds her arms.

shots.camera: Medium close-up, low angle, locked-off camera, on Ji Ran
shots.visual: Ji Ran, deadpan, points one finger past Lin Qingyu toward the office door.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Ji Ran, in Chinese, flat and dismissive): {未到法定婚龄，出门左拐不送。}

shots.camera: Close-up, quick push in, eye-level, on Lin Qingyu's face
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu's jaw drops and his eyes widen in disbelief.

shots.camera: Wide shot, slow pull out, eye-level, from the lounge-area side
shots.visual: Lin Qingyu stands frozen in front of the desk with the office door behind him. Ji Ran turns away toward the walnut desk as the image softens into drifting, glowing light.

segments.light_audio: Bright soft daylight through the floor-to-ceiling windows behind the desk, warm recessed ceiling spots and the brass desk lamp fill. At the end the image blooms into soft drifting light. Live sound: faint rain on the glass, a sigh.

dialogue.speaker: ji_ran
dialogue.line: 未到法定婚龄，出门左拐不送。

must_hit: Ji Ran sighs in disappointment after hearing his age
Ji Ran points toward the door and dismisses him
Lin Qingyu reacts stunned as the image softens into drifting light
segments.exit_state: Lin Qingyu stands frozen and dumbfounded in the open space in front of the walnut desk, with the closed office door behind him. Ji Ran has turned toward the walnut desk. The image is softened in drifting light.
negative: Lin Qingyu walking out of the room
camera crossing to the window side of the axis
